text: D2 took a sole name/arity candidate without checking its signature, so IFoo.Baz(Integer) would select a lone Impl.Baz(Text); the raw stable-id hash also preserves quote/whitespace spelling, so a real implementation could be missed.
evidence: D2.0 adds a separate interface-match key (folded name, per-param var flag + normalized type, normalized return; case-fold, whitespace collapse, unquote) computed by one function for the declaration and every candidate; D2.3 requires the key match even for a single candidate; the stable-id hash is unchanged. Tests A3b (lone wrong signature -> diagnostic) and A3c (spelling difference matches). Revision 3: A3c is now a quote+whitespace difference with an overload (interface Qux(C: Record Customer) vs ImplA Qux(C: Record  "Customer") plus Qux(C: Record Vendor)), so dropping normalization yields a diagnostic, not the root; the key is token-aware (see N1).

evidence: D2.2 groups candidates by stable routine id before the pick; D2.4 pushes every span of the chosen id. Test A7 (#if CLEAN/#else Bar is one root with both anchors; an interface whose #if arms repeat Bar dedups viaInterface/diagnostics). Discrimination (5).

text: The revision-2 key normalization (sig_fp::normalize_type_text + unquote) collapses whitespace inside quoted identifiers (sig_fp.rs:69-74), so Record "A  B" equals Record "A B" and a lone wrong-table candidate could be accepted.
evidence: D2.0 now builds on scope::canonicalize_type_text (scope.rs:54, collapses whitespace only outside quotes), case-folds, unescapes doubled quotes with the existing unescape_al_identifier (scope.rs:97), and drops quotes only around plain identifiers; sig_fp::normalize_type_text is explicitly not used. A3d negative ("A B" vs "A  B" -> diagnostic) and discrimination (4b).
